Upload an image, video or .glb model (multipart/form-data: file, optional purpose)
post.description: Field `file` (required) and optional text field `purpose` (e.g. `builder-model`, which requires a .glb). The type is judged by file content. Images up to 10 MB are auto-rotated, stripped of metadata, resized to at most 2000 px on the long side and saved as WebP (transparent PNGs stay PNG); SVGs with scripts or external references are refused. MP4/WebM up to 100 MB, GLB up to 50 MB. `413 FILE_TOO_LARGE` carries `details.maxBytes`, `415 UNSUPPORTED_FILE_TYPE` carries `details.allowed`.
